author: @KobeissiLetter
title: US deficit widens to $1.99 trillion
excerpt:
BREAKING: The US deficit widened to $1.99 trillion for FY2026, up +12% from the $1.78 trillion recorded last year.

Spending rose by +6%, to $7.4 trillion, and NET interest officially rose above $1 trillion.

Debt servicing costs are now their third largest expense for the US government, only behind Social Security and Medicare.

This marks the fourth-straight year with the US fiscal deficit around $2 trillion.

The deficit spending crisis is out of control.
